aliases: Kingdom of Castile / 卡斯蒂利亚王国

nameForms.name: Kingdom of Castile
nameForms.note: This recorded royal line begins with Ferdinand I of León and Castile; it does not extend into the earlier Navarrese or Leonese background.
nameForms.noteCn: 本王位记录始于莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚的费尔南多一世；不向更早的纳瓦拉或莱昂前史延伸。

nameForms.name: Crown of Castile
nameForms.note: From 1516 Castile formed part of the Spanish composite monarchy while retaining its institutions and royal style.
nameForms.noteCn: 1516年起，卡斯蒂利亚进入西班牙复合君主制，同时保留自身制度与王号。

holders.note: First Jiménez king in this Castilian royal line.
holders.noteCn: 本卡斯蒂利亚王位链的首位希梅纳国王。

holders.note: Received Castile in Ferdinand I's 1065 partition.
holders.noteCn: 在1065年费尔南多一世分封中取得卡斯蒂利亚。

holders.note: Succeeded Sancho II and reunited the León-Castile monarchy.
holders.noteCn: 继承桑乔二世，并重新统一莱昂—卡斯蒂利亚王权。

holders.note: Ruling queen in her own right, succeeding her father Alfonso VI.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利继承父亲阿方索六世的实权女王。

holders.note: The crown passed through Urraca; Alfonso VII's paternal house was Iberian Burgundy.
holders.noteCn: 王位经乌拉卡继承；阿方索七世的父系家族转为伊比利亚勃艮第支。

holders.note: After Alfonso VII's death, Castile and León were divided again.
holders.noteCn: 阿方索七世去世后，卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂再次分治。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Sancho III as king of the separate Castilian realm.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲桑乔三世，成为分治后卡斯蒂利亚王国的国王。

holders.note: Succeeded Alfonso VIII as a minor king.
holders.noteCn: 作为未成年君主继承阿方索八世。

holders.note: Inherited in her own right and transferred the crown to Ferdinand III.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利继承王位，并将王冠移交给费尔南多三世。

holders.note: Succeeded through his mother Berengaria.
holders.noteCn: 经其母贝伦加丽亚继承王位。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Ferdinand III.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父费尔南多三世。

holders.note: Succeeded Alfonso X after a disputed succession.
holders.noteCn: 在有争议的继承后继承阿方索十世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Sancho IV as a minor.
holders.noteCn: 作为未成年君主继承其父桑乔四世。

holders.note: Succeeded Ferdinand IV and reached his majority under regency.
holders.noteCn: 继承费尔南多四世，并在摄政下成年亲政。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Alfonso XI.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父阿方索十一世。

holders.note: Seized the crown during the Castilian civil war.
holders.noteCn: 在卡斯蒂利亚内战中夺取王位。

holders.note: Recovered the throne with English support before his final defeat.
holders.noteCn: 在英格兰支持下收复王位，后最终战败。

holders.note: Restored Trastámara rule after Peter I's death.
holders.noteCn: 彼得一世死后恢复特拉斯塔马拉统治。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Henry II.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父亨利二世。

holders.note: Succeeded John I as a minor.
holders.noteCn: 作为未成年君主继承约翰一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Henry III.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父亨利三世。

holders.note: Succeeded John II.
holders.noteCn: 继承约翰二世。

holders.note: Succeeded Henry IV in her own right.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利继承亨利四世。

holders.note: Succeeded her mother Isabella I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其母伊莎贝拉一世。

holders.note: Ruled with Joanna by marital right.
holders.noteCn: 凭婚姻权利与胡安娜共同统治。

holders.note: Retained the crown after Philip I's death.
holders.noteCn: 腓力一世去世后保有王冠。

holders.note: Remained queen in law within the Spanish composite monarchy.
holders.noteCn: 在西班牙复合君主制中仍为法理上的卡斯蒂利亚女王。

holders.note: Became co-monarch with Joanna in the Crown of Castile.
holders.noteCn: 在卡斯蒂利亚王冠下成为胡安娜的共同君主。
